name: RIVR Bioregional Commons App
description: RIVR sovereign bioregional commons instance. Canonical codebase is rivr-bioregional. NOTE: the live Front Range instance currently runs the GLOBAL codebase (use rivr-global with INSTANCE_TYPE=region); this module is for true bioregional-codebase deployments. One env-parameterized module serves every region-codebase instance; instances differ ONLY by .env.

domain.description: Public host for this instance (Traefik Host rule + NEXT_PUBLIC_DOMAIN), e.g. front-range.rivr.social

baseUrl.description: Absolute public base URL (https://<domain>); drives NEXTAUTH_URL + NEXT_PUBLIC_* URLs

instanceSlug.description: Per-instance slug; differentiates container_name + Traefik router

registryUrl.description: Federation registry endpoint of the global this node federates to

globalIdentityAuthorityUrl.description: Global instance URL that aggregates identity for this node

primaryAgentId.description: UUID of this node's primary/owner agent

imageRef.description: Container image reference; overrides the built image. Pin to a digest in production.
